label: negative
rationale_zh: 本次提交新增解析选项 XML_PARSE_NO_XXE（禁止加载外部实体与外部 DTD），在 parser.c / SAX2.c 的多处实体加载判断中引入新的选项分支。这与“新增选项、harness 硬编码选项导致新分支不可达”的隐式阳性在表面上完全相同。但 xml 这个 harness 的解析选项来自输入（xmlFuzzReadInt(4)），只屏蔽了少数选项，新的选项位会被随机置位；定额 fuzz 下“选项已置位”的分支在多个种子中被实际执行。动了 harness 相关的选项接口但无需修改 harness，属于隐式 api 阴性。
rationale_en: This commit adds the parser option XML_PARSE_NO_XXE (no loading of external entities or the external DTD), introducing new option branches in several entity-loading checks in parser.c and SAX2.c. On the surface this is identical to a silent positive where a new option is unreachable because the harness hard-codes its options. But the xml harness takes its parser options from the input (xmlFuzzReadInt(4)) and masks only a few of them, so the new bit gets set at random; under the fuzz budget the option-set branches are executed in several seeds. A change touching the harness-relevant option interface that needs no harness update: silent api negative.
